_comment: ★2026-08-07: 这份 spec 是 mindserver socket 'create-agent' 的硬白名单 —— 不在里面的键会被 delete 掉。历史上它的 default 与仓库根 settings.js 漂移了很久（host/init_message/chat_ingame/allow_vision/base_profile 全对不上），造成'面板显示的默认值和实际跑的不是一回事'。本次已逐条对齐 settings.js。以后改 settings.js 必须同步改这里。玩家可见的设置项另有一份中文清单在 src/mindcraft/panel/config_store.js，那份才是控制面板用的。

profile.description: The profile object to use, including name, prompts, and examples

minecraft_version.description: The version of Minecraft to use. Set to 'auto' to automatically detect the version.

host.description: The minecraft server host address to connect to

port.description: The minecraft server port to connect to. -1 for auto-detect.

player_username.description: The real in-game username of the human player the bot should treat as its owner (used by !goToPlayer/!followPlayer/etc. when the chat sender isn't a real player). Leave empty to auto-detect the LAN host / single-player owner at runtime.

mindserver_port.description: Port the mindserver (control panel + agent hub) listens on. Changing it requires restarting the whole program and reopening the panel on the new port.

auto_open_ui.description: Open the control panel in the default browser a few seconds after startup.

profiles.description: Profile file paths to launch. Relative paths are resolved against the user home layer first, then the app directory. main.js falls back to bot.json / neko.json when this is empty.

chat_command_prefix.description: In-game chat command prefix (2026-07-14): a real-player message starting with this prefix (or with '!') is treated as a high-priority admin command; other real-player chat is throttled and forwarded to the external admin LLM. Empty string = disabled (legacy behavior: every real-player message is treated as a command). Must be listed here or the mindserver socket-create path strips it before it reaches the agent.

chat_whitelist.description: In-game player names whose chat/commands are processed (2026-07-14). Empty array = all real players allowed.

base_profile.description: Allowed values: survival, assistant, creative, god_mode. Each has fine tuned settings for different game modes.

load_memory.description: Whether to load bot's previous memory

init_message.description: The initial message to send to the bot on spawn. Empty = say nothing.

only_chat_with.description: List of agents to only chat with. If empty, the bot will chat publicly

speak.description: Whether to enable text-to-speech reading on the host machine

language.description: The language to automatically translate to and from using google translate

allow_vision.description: Whether to allow vision capabilities (enables the real vision path for !lookAtPlayer/!lookAtPosition; vision_model falls back to chat_model when not set in the profile)

thinking.description: LLM thinking/reasoning mode: off (recommended for a game bot — low latency, and reasoning text leaking into content breaks !command parsing), low, or auto (leave it to the model default). The concrete request-body shape per provider lives in src/models/providers.js.

blocked_actions.description: List of actions that are blocked. '!restart' and '!stfu' are blocked because the LLM was observed entering a self-restart loop (every task answered with !restart → cleanKill → respawn → same history → !restart again).

relevant_docs_count.description: Number of relevant function documents to include in the prompt for LLM code writing

max_messages.description: Maximum number of recent messages to keep in context for LLM

num_examples.description: Number of examples to select to help prompt better LLM responses

max_commands.description: Maximum number of commands allowed in consecutive responses. -1 for no limit

narrate_behavior.description: Whether to openly chat automatic behavior like 'Picking up item!'

log_all_prompts.description: Whether to log all prompts to file. Can be very verbose.

show_command_syntax.description: Whether to show "full" command syntax, "shortened" command syntax, or "none"

chat_ingame.description: Whether to show bot's chat messages in game chat

chat_bot_messages.description: Whether to publicly chat messages to and from other bots

render_bot_view.description: Whether to render bot view for user observation. Does not give bot vision.

allow_insecure_coding.description: Whether to allow newAction command that let's LLM write/run code on host computer. Despite sandboxxing, it is potentially insecure.

code_timeout_mins.description: Number of minutes to allow code execution. -1 for no timeout

block_place_delay.description: Delay in ms between placing blocks when running generated code. Raise it if the server's anti-cheat kicks the bot for building too fast.

spawn_timeout.description: Number of seconds allowed for the bot to spawn before throwing an error. Increase when spawning takes a while.
